articles.title: 1,375 Days Later: Serena Williams Returns, Wins, and Jokes About Dinner Plans
articles.summary: Serena Williams ended a 1,375-day tennis hiatus with a doubles win at Queen's Club, partnering 19-year-old Victoria Mboko. Her post-match interview revealed her daughters were more interested in toys and dinner than her legendary comeback.

articles.title: Spielberg Ditched Harry Potter to Honor Kubrick—and Gave Us a Sci-Fi Cult Classic
articles.summary: Steven Spielberg revealed he abandoned directing the first Harry Potter film to fulfill a promise to the late Stanley Kubrick, making A.I. Artificial Intelligence instead. The decision led to one of his most ambitious and divisive films.

articles.title: How the Mona Lisa Heist Turned a Painting Into a Superstar—and a New Lloyd Webber Musical
articles.summary: Andrew Lloyd Webber is writing a musical about the 1911 theft of the Mona Lisa by Louvre worker Vincenzo Peruggia. The bizarre true story transformed the painting into a global icon and now inspires Broadway's hitmaker.
